title: Orthotropic axial modulus sensitivity
source: Independent orthotropic uniaxial scaling: with nu=0, guided transverse motion and load along material axis 1, the axial response is proportional to 1/E1 and the modal frequency is proportional to sqrt(E1).

quantities.quantity: E1 times static tip derivative divided by tip displacement
quantities.reason: Exact guided uniaxial scaling of the orthotropic constitutive matrix in direction 1.

quantities.quantity: 2E1 times first frequency derivative divided by frequency
quantities.reason: The guided eigenproblem has stiffness proportional to E1 and fixed mass.
